scope: Read-only real-file inventory and bounded real-frame recompression, CPU regression tests, bounded synthetic generation and PLINK preparation, plus old/new synthetic GPU public-entry regression. No full reference-scale generation or conversion.

reference_file_inventory.interpretation: Existing real files measured independently of new synthetic generation. Metadata, retained original input and genotype cache are separate storage components.

historical_estimate_correction.correct_interpretation: Loose doubled uncompressed CSR exception upper bound plus 768 bytes per variant metadata allowance; neither measured output nor compressed final-size prediction.

full_reference_dry_run.method: At most twelve expected-exception strata per chromosome and eight synthetic variants per stratum, with requested n and integer AC/AN unchanged. Probe row-delta sample indices with Zstd level 3; account metadata, catalogs, sample axes, journal/index/headers/counts and metadata raw-to-NPY staging separately.
full_reference_dry_run.margins: Genotype probe estimate times 1.75 plus fixed allowance, metadata times 1.05 plus fixed allowance; sensitivity margins are not confidence intervals or a completion guarantee.
full_reference_dry_run.limitations: Independent synthetic calls do not reconstruct biological LD or guarantee the real-data compression ratio. No measured whole-dataset disk peak.

bounded_real_frame_recompression.scope: Bounded frame sample only; not a measured whole-genome saving or speed benchmark.

bounded_synthetic_generator.allocation_interpretation: Unchanged SHA-identical sample-axis files had different physical allocation between runs; the whole-directory allocation difference cannot be attributed to the codec. Payload reduction and logical sizes are reported separately.
bounded_synthetic_generator.timing_scope: Single shared-node pair with uncontrolled cache state; no speedup claim.

bounded_plink_preparation.cache_admission: Existing ten-percent retained BED rule, metadata excluded from genotype cap and measured separately.
bounded_plink_preparation.storage_report: Separates logical lengths, allocated blocks, inode-deduplicated allocation, source, genotype cache, metadata and temporary directories. Phase-boundary measurements are not a measured disk high-water mark.
bounded_plink_preparation.timing_scope: Single warm shared-node pair; no speedup claim.

gpu_public_entry_regression.scope: Bounded same-input storage compatibility and association-output regression, not an official same-input accuracy comparison or full-scale GPU run.

label_policies.binary_available: impute_missing=False: use the available samples for each phenotype after covariate matching.
label_policies.binary_impute: impute_missing=True: fill missing binary labels as controls after covariate matching.
label_policies.continuous_available: rm_nan=False: use the available samples for each phenotype after covariate matching.
label_policies.continuous_mean_imputed: rm_nan=True: after covariate matching, fill missing continuous labels using the mean of the available values for that phenotype.

format_and_statistics.variant_mode: Synthetic Indel/PTV retained; mature association variant mode does not apply numerical annotation weighting.
format_and_statistics.snv_mode: Explicit SNV mode exercises numerical annotation weights and changes non-SNV eligibility.

tested_runtime_binding.sha256_manifest_format: SHA256 of canonical JSON mapping sorted package-relative Python path to file SHA256
